message.content: {"hts_code": "7616.99.5190", "reason": "The aluminum hollow elbow bracket connects a hand railing to a post or wall but is not a structure or part thereof, so it is classified as other articles of aluminum."
message.reasoning: Aluminum bracket for railings — other aluminum articles? Likely 7616.99.01 or aluminum structural mountings/fittings 7610.90.00? Brackets of aluminum — 8302.42? No, aluminum. Mountings/fittings 7610.90.0090? Actually 7610 covers aluminum structures and parts thereof; brackets for railings could be 7610.90.00. But "other articles of aluminum" 7616.99.51. Ruling style: elbow fitting connecting railing to post — likely 7610.90.0090? Hmm. Similar rulings classify aluminum railing fittings under 7616.99.51. I'll go 7616.99.5190? Actually 7616.99.51 is "other, of aluminum, not alloyed"? 7616.99.51: Other articles of aluminum: other: 7616.99.5190? Post-2022: 7616.99.51 covers other articles of aluminum. Use 7616.99.5190.
